news.content: Ready Lab welcomes visiting student Iris Huić from the University of Zagreb
Marjan Naghshbandi successfully defended her MASc thesis
Chuma Asuzu successfully defended his PhD thesis
Liz DaMaren awarded the CEEA Engineering Education Student Award
Shuo Yin and Lia Campbell joined Ready Lab as undergraduate summer research students

Meagan Flus published an open-access dataset of transcript data collected from a hackathon team, titled *“Hackathon Archive of Collaboration Knowledge and Engineering Design (HACKED): Hackathon 1 Transcript Sample.”* You can access the data here: [https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/7CCTYU](https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/7CCTYU)

Meagan Flus published the paper, [Presenting Hackathon Data for Design Research: A Transcript Dataset](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.4067866) in the Journal of Mechanical Design with co-author Gregory Litster and supervised by Alison Olechowski.
Elisa Kwon joined Ready Lab as a Postdoctoral Fellow and Kevin Zhang joined as a MASc student.

Sharon Ferguson, Meagan Flus, Elisa Kwon, Marjan Naghshbandi, Genevieve Beirne, Liz DaMaren, and Chuma Asuzu attended the Canadian Design Workshop 3 at the University of Waterloo. Elisa chaired the workshop, Exploring opportunities and challenges of using LLMs and AI in design. Meagan and Sharon chaired the workshop, Designing design research: Lessons from design researchers, and served on the Organizing Committee.
Dr. Sharon Ferguson successfully defended her PhD dissertation in December 2024! Congratulations on this amazing achievement!
Marjan Naghshbandi presented at the Massey College Ursula Franklin Forum on Science and Engineering and won an honourable mention.
Sharon Ferguson and Kathy Cheng presented papers at the ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work and Social Computing (CSCW) in Costa Rica.
Pranav Khanolkar successfully defended his PhD dissertation in November 2024! Congratulations on this amazing achievement!
Meagan Flus was invited to attend Hack the Hackathon 4 at the Scripps Institute of Oceanography at the University of San Diego.
Meagan Flus was a Visiting Scholar in the Technology and Human Research in Engineering Design Group (THRED) at the Pennsylvania State University, working with Dr. Jessica Menold.
Sharon Ferguson was a Visiting Scholar in the CAD lab at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, working with Dr. David Wallace and Dr. Jim Magarian.
Pranav Khanolkar was a panelist at the DAIR to Innovate event hosted by Bombardier.

Ready Lab graduate students, Pranav Khanolkar, Sharon Ferguson, Meagan Flus, Kathy Cheng, and Chuma Asuzu presented at the MIE Graduate Research Symposium. Meagan won first place in the Poster Presentation category “Applied Mechanics and Design.”
Marjan Naghshbandi won a NSERC Canadian Graduate Scholarship - Master's.
Marjan Naghshbandi and Felix Deng joined Ready Lab as MASc students.
Jordan Epp successfully defended his MASc thesis. Congratulations, Jordan and best of luck in your next endeavors!

Pranav Khanolkar and Kevin Zhang presented papers at the International Design Engineering Technical Conferences and Computers and Information in Engineering Conference (IDETC) in Washington DC. Kathy Cheng presented and was a panelist at the “The Trove of CAD Informatics: Acquiring and Analyzing CAD Data for Design Process Insights and AI Applications” workshop at IDETC.
Genevieve Beirne presented her work at the Undergraduate Engineering Research Day (UnERD).
Chuma Asuzu has been accepted to attend the PDMA Doctoral Consortium in Syracuse
Jordan Epp had a poster titled “Configuration Management Strategy for Model-based Product Line Engineering in Aircraft Systems Development” at INCOSE IS2024

Meagan Flus presented a paper at the Design Computing and Cognition 2024 conference titled Examining Conflict Patterns in Hackathon Teams: A Case Study. The paper is co-authored by Julianne Attai, Meagan Flus, and Alison Olechowski.
Kevin Zhang presented a paper at the CAD Conference and Exhibition.

Meagan Flus chaired a workshop titled, Transparency and Collaboration: A Workshop on Open Access Design Team Data at the Design Computing and Cognition 2024 conference. Collaborators include Sharon Ferguson (Ready Lab), Yuval Kahlon (Tokyo Institute of Technology), Gregory Litster (UofT), Christopher McComb (Carnegie Mellon), and Alison Olechowski (Ready Lab).
Sharon Ferguson accepted an offer to join the Management Science and Engineering Department at the University of Waterloo as an Assistant Professor in 2025
Jordan Epp published [“Transitioning Towards SysML v2 as a Variability Modeling Language”](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11334-024-00569-y) in Innovations in Systems and Software Engineering

Marjan Naghshbandi presented our work “Social Capital and Persistence in Computer Science of Google's Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI) Students” at the 2024 American Society for Engineering Education (ASEE) Conference in Portland. The paper is co-authored by Marjan Naghshbandi, Sharon Ferguson, and Dr. Alison Olechowski.
Marjan Naghshbandi won the W. S. Wilson Medal in Industrial Engineering for highest academic standing in the final year of Industrial Engineering
Meagan Flus is continuing on for a second year as the Student Director on the Canadian Engineering Education Association Board of Directors
Meagan Flus presented a Lightning Talk titled, Unleashing Collaborative Potential: A Case Study of Peer Learning at Hackathons, at the Canadian Engineering Education Association Annual Conference
Chuma Asuzu presented “Differences in Consumers' Interpretations of Novel and Familiar Product Designs: An Exploratory Study of Visual References” at IPDMC 2024 in Dublin

Chuma Asuzu and Kathy Cheng had a paper published in IEEE Transactions on Engineering Management: [The Personas of Cloud CAD Collaboration: A Case Study of a Team of CAD Professionals](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10547390?source=authoralert)

Sharon Ferguson and Alison Olechowski were awarded a research gift from [Microsoft's AI and the New Future of Work program](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/academic-program/ai-and-the-new-future-of-work/recipients/)
Esdras Paravizo, a PhD candidate from the University of Cambridge, joined Ready Lab as a Visiting Scholar.
This summer, Chuma Asuzu is a visiting student at the Department of Marketing of Goethe University in Frankfurt
Undergraduate students Genevieve Beirne, Marjan Naghshbandi, and Avelyn Wong joined Ready Lab for the summer

Meagan Flus presented work titled Integrated Co-design: A novel collaboration framework from the electro-thermal design process of power electronics systems at the Canadian Society for Mechanical Engineering International Congress 2024. The paper is co-authored by Omri Tayyara, Ademir Vrolijk, Carlos M. Da Silva, Cristina Amon, and Alison Olechowski.
Kathy Cheng won a NSERC Canada Graduate Scholarship - Doctoral
Sharon Ferguson, Georgia Van De Zande, and Alison Olechowski had a poster presentation “No Risk, No Reward: Towards An Automated Measure of Psychological Safety from Online Communication” at CHI 2024

Meagan Flus published a Research Note in the Journal of Engineering Design. Full citation: Lawrie, E., Flus, M, Olechowski, A., Hay, L., Wodehouse, A. 2024. From theory to practice: a roadmap for applying dual-process theory in design cognition research. Journal of Engineering Design, 1-21. doi:10.1080/09544828.2024.2336837

Alison Olechowski won the [Cheryl Regehr UofT Early Career Teaching Award](https://www.mie.utoronto.ca/professor-alison-olechowski-honoured-with-the-2023-24-cheryl-regehr-early-career-teaching-award/)
Chuma Asuzu won a German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) Research Grant in March 2024
Emma Lawrie, a PhD candidate from the University of Strathclyde, joined Ready Lab as a Visiting Scholar.
Meagan Flus was invited to attend Hack the Hackathon 3 in Geneva, Switzerland

Kathy Cheng presented at CSCW 2023 in Minneapolis: “In the Age of Collaboration, the Computer-Aided Design Ecosystem is Behind: An Interview Study of Distributed CAD Practice” and “User Perspectives on Branching in Computer-Aided Design”
Sharon Ferguson presented “Are We Equal Online?: An Investigation of Gendered Language Patterns and Message Engagement on Enterprise Communication Platforms” at CSCW 2023 in Minneapolis
Alison Olechowski presented a keynote at the Oak Ridge National Lab's Manufacturing Demonstration Facility

Alison Olechowski, Tucker Marion, Mohsen Moghaddam, Chris McComb, Kate Fu, and Katja Holtta-Otto host [ASME IDETC-CIE 2023 Workshop: Emerging Technologies and Methods for Early Stage Product Design and Development](https://readylab.mie.utoronto.ca/workshop/), on August 20, 2023

Ademir Vrolijk, Pranav Khanolkar, Meagan Flus, and Chuma Asuzu presented at the 24th International Conference on Engineering Design, 24-28 July 2023, in Bordeaux, France, with Ademir and Meagan achieving the reveiwer's favorite award.
Sharon Ferguson joins Future of Work team at Slack as a doctoral research intern in summer

Alison Olechowski and Roger Carrick received Learning & Education Advancement Fund (LEAF) Seed fund for their work “Improving Collaborative Learning Approaches in Computer-Aided Design Project-Based Learning”
Lucus Crupi joins Tesla as a battery engineering intern in summer
Ainsley Ross-Howe and Alexander Lyakishev joined Ready Lab as summer undergraduate interns
Liz DaMaren received the NSERC Postgraduate Scholarship - Doctoral award
Sharon Ferguson presented her work “Something Borrowed: Exploring the Influence of AI-Generated Explanation Text on the Composition of Human Explanation” at CHI2023 in Hamburg, Germany
Alison Olechowki awarded Early Career Teaching Award for demonstrating exceptional classsroom instruction and teaching methods
Jordan Epp got accepted into the 2023 Frontiers in Design Representation (FinDeR) Summer School at University of Maryland, US
Jordan Epp and Alison Olechowski received the NSERC Alliance Grant (ALLRP) for their research in collaboration with Safran Landing Systems Canada

Ademir Vrolijk had his paper “The Opportunists in Innovation Contests: Understanding Who to Attract and How to Attract Them” published in the [Research-Technology Management journal](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/08956308.2022.2132771)
Two new graduate students joined the Ready Lab team: Chuma Asuzu and Jordan Epp

Lab members presented conference papers at a wide variety of conferences, including [DRS](https://www.drs2022.org/), [DCC](https://sites.google.com/view/dcc22/), [ASME IDETC](https://event.asme.org/IDETC-CIE), [CAD Conference](http://www.cad-conference.net/files/CAD22/CAD22-beijing.html#.YzW-6XbMJPY), [CEEA](https://ceea.ca/conference/conference-2022/), [ASEE](https://www.asee.org/events/Conferences-and-Meetings/2022-Annual-Conference), and [INCOSE](https://www.incose.org/symp2022/home/when-where)
Ademir Vrolijk had his paper “The Opportunists in Innovation Contests: Understanding Who to Attract and How to Attract Them” accepted to the Research-Technology Management journal
Dr. Olechowski presented at a panel during the [Onshape Research Symposium](https://www.onshape.com/en/education/research-symposium/) on Understanding Collaborative Design with Onshape Analytics
Kathy Cheng was awarded a 2022-2023 Ontario Graduate Scholarship

Sharon Ferguson, Kathy Cheng, and previous Ready Lab student Lauren Adolphe had their paper “Communication patterns in engineering enterprise social networks: an exploratory analysis using short text topic modelling” [published in Design Science](https://doi.org/10.1017/dsj.2022.12)

The paper written in collaboration with several members of Ready Lab, led by Sharon Ferguson, “'Why couldn't we do this more often?': exploring the feasibility of virtual and distributed work in product design engineering”, was published in [Research in Engineering Design](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00163-022-00391-2)
Ademir Vrolijk joined Ready Lab as a post-doc
Meagan Flus and Sharon Ferguson were both awarded NSERC Canada Graduate Scholarship - Doctoral program awards, and Liz DaMaren was awarded a NSERC Canada Graduate Scholarship - Master's program award

Dr. Olechowski presented recent work on collaborative CAD at the [INFORMS 2021 Annual Meeting](https://meetings2.informs.org/wordpress/anaheim2021/registration/?utm_campaign=2021%20Annual&utm_source=ppc&utm_medium=display&utm_term=2021annual&utm_content=register&utm_term=academic%20conferences%202020&utm_campaign=INFORMS+2021+Annual+Meeting&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_tgt=kwd-820551576932&hsa_grp=122192662736&hsa_src=g&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_mt=b&hsa_ver=3&hsa_ad=519146125868&hsa_acc=6773547382&hsa_kw=academic%20conferences%202020&hsa_cam=12964274846&gclid=Cj0KCQjw8eOLBhC1ARIsAOzx5cGnmzHr7dGOCcoAsI-K4Rscvd6I6eGd8l9xnj79UKT7xoRBun31HO0aAvWzEALw_wcB), session: Idea to Product to Business

Dr. Olechowski and collaborators at [RPS Composites](https://rpscomposites.com/) receive a [MITACS Accelerate](https://www.mitacs.ca/en/programs/accelerate) grant to support Pranav Khanolkar on the project “A new automated approach for Engineering Design and Manufacturing Specification generation”

Dr. Olechowski was a speaker on the [signature event panel](https://event.asme.org/IDETC-CIE-2021/Program/Keynotes-Special-Sessions) “The Future of Human-AI Collaboration for Engineering Design” at the Design Automation Conference track at the ASME International Design Engineering Technical Conferences & Computers and Information in Engineering Conference.
Ready Lab students Kevin Leonardo, Kathy Cheng and Sharon Ferguson presented their work at the [ASME IDETC conference](https://event.asme.org/IDETC-CIE-2021).
Dr. Olechowski and collaborator Dr. Tucker Marion presented work at the [ICED'21](https://iced.designsociety.org/) conference.

Summer undergraduate researcher Michal Davis won best poster in the Transdisciplinary Engineering Education and Practice category at the [2021 UnERD conference](https://undergrad.engineering.utoronto.ca/skule-life/undergraduate-engineering-research-day-unerd/).

Sharon Ferguson won Oral Presentation First Place in the Data Analytics, Robotics & AI division at the [U of T Engineering Research Conference](https://gradstudies.engineering.utoronto.ca/u-of-t-engineering-research-conference/)
Kimberly Lai's paper was awarded “Best Student Paper” at the 2021 INCOSE International Symposium
Ready Lab students Kimberly Lai and Eric van Velzen both virtually presented their papers at the [2021 INCOSE International Symposium](https://www.incose.org/symp2021/home)
We had an awesome time running a “Learn to Code” outreach workshop for the teen leaders program of [Camp Ooch and Camp Trillium](https://ooch.org/)

Watch a recording of Dr. Olechowski's [webinar](https://www.colabsoftware.com/webinars/the-future-will-be-model-based-are-you-ready) “How Mechanical Engineers Can Prepare for a Model-Based Future” with Mark Morreale of [Colab](https://www.colabsoftware.com/)
Dr. Olechowski was a panelist on the [Mental Health in Engineering webinar](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OSxi97c16fY) hosted by the Ontario Society of Professional Engineers

Dr. Olechowski delivered keynote presentation at the PTC Digital Transformation in Education Summit: [Reimagining Design Education with Cloud CAD](https://youtu.be/xQaoCL4cv4g?t=6) which was also featured in [this blog](https://www.onshape.com/en/resource-center/innovation-blog/top-five-reasons-why-cloud-based-cad-is-a-game-changer-for-design-education) article.

Dr. Olechowski and [Dr. Zhou](https://www.eecg.utoronto.ca/~shuruiz/) of Electrical and Computer Engineering received [CARTE](https://carte.utoronto.ca/) Seed Funding for a collaborative two-year project: “Analysis of Computer-Aided Design Data: Applying Software Development Principles to Physical Product Design”

Dr. Olechowski co-organized [Conceptualizing Black Experiences In Engineering Virtual Panel](https://ospe.on.ca/register/?type=event&id=2540) with [OSPE](https://ospe.on.ca/) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com/en-US)

Dr. Olechowski received a [SSHRC Knowledge Synthesis Grants - Skills and Work in the Digital Economy](https://www.sshrc-crsh.gc.ca/results-resultats/recipients-recipiendaires/2020/ksg_digital_economy-ssc_economie_numerique-eng.aspx): “A Modern Canadian Engineering Design Curriculum: Balancing Artificial Intelligence and Human Cognition”

Dr. Olechowski and collaborators at [Safran Landing Systems](https://www.safran-landing-systems.com/) receive a [MITACS Accelerate](https://www.mitacs.ca/en/programs/accelerate) grant to study “Integration of Safety Analysis into Model-Based Systems Engineering”

Dr. Olechowski co-organized [Female Leaders and the Changing Landscape of Engineering](https://ospe.on.ca/register/?type=event&id=2420) with [OSPE](https://ospe.on.ca/) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com/en-US)
Dr. Olechowski served on the Program Committee for the inaugural [Canadian Design Workshop](https://uwaterloo.ca/canadian-design-workshop/)
